arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللهَ (ثَلَاثاً) اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
transliteration: Astaghfirullah (three times). Allahumma Antas-Salam waminkas-salam, tabarakta ya Thal-Jalali wal-Ikram.
translation: I ask Allah for forgiveness (three times). O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, O Owner of majesty and honor.
